sentences.english: See you on Monday!
sentences.chinese: 星期一见！

sentences.english: I hate Monday mornings because I have to wake up early again.
sentences.chinese: 我讨厌星期一早晨，因为又得早起了。

sentences.english: Last Monday was so rainy that the traffic was terrible and I was almost an hour late for work.
sentences.chinese: 上周一下大雨，交通一塌糊涂，我上班迟到了快一个小时。

sentences.english: We have art class on Tuesday.
sentences.chinese: 我们星期二有美术课。

sentences.english: I'll meet you at the library next Tuesday after school.
sentences.chinese: 我下周二放学后在图书馆等你。

sentences.english: Every Tuesday evening, my family orders pizza and we all sit in the living room to catch up on our week.
sentences.chinese: 每周二晚上，我们家都会点披萨，然后坐在客厅聊聊这一周发生的事。

sentences.english: It's Wednesday already!
sentences.chinese: 已经星期三了！

sentences.english: We have a math test on Wednesday, so I'm studying all evening.
sentences.chinese: 我们星期三有数学考试，我整晚都在复习。

sentences.english: On Wednesday mornings, the office provides free bagels and coffee, and that's honestly the only reason I get out of bed on time.
sentences.chinese: 周三早上办公室有免费百吉饼和咖啡，说实话这是唯一能让我准时起床的理由。
sentences.scene: 办公室福利让人期待周三

sentences.english: My piano lesson is on Thursday.
sentences.chinese: 我星期四有钢琴课。

sentences.english: Let's have dinner together this Thursday at that new Italian place.
sentences.chinese: 这个周四我们一起去那家新开的意大利餐厅吃饭吧。

sentences.english: I always feel hopeful on Thursday because the weekend is almost here, and I can finally relax.
sentences.chinese: 周四我总是充满希望，因为周末快到了，终于可以放松了。

sentences.english: Thank God it's Friday!
sentences.chinese: 谢天谢地，星期五了！

sentences.english: We usually go out for a movie and burgers on Friday night.
sentences.chinese: 我们周五晚上通常会出去看电影吃汉堡。

sentences.english: Last Friday, we stayed up late playing board games and laughing so hard that our neighbors knocked on the wall.
sentences.chinese: 上周五我们熬夜玩桌游，笑得前仰后合，邻居都敲墙抗议了。

sentences.english: I sleep in on Saturday.
sentences.chinese: 我星期六睡懒觉。

sentences.english: On Saturday, we're taking the kids to the zoo for the first time.
sentences.chinese: 星期六我们要第一次带孩子们去动物园。

sentences.english: My perfect Saturday starts with a big pancake breakfast, then a long walk in the park, and finishes with a movie night at home.
sentences.chinese: 我完美的周六从丰盛的煎饼早餐开始，然后在公园里长时间散步，最后以家庭电影之夜结束。

sentences.english: Sunday is a day of rest.
sentences.chinese: 周日是休息日。

sentences.english: On Sunday afternoons, we visit my grandparents and have tea together.
sentences.chinese: 周日下午我们会去看望爷爷奶奶，一起喝茶。

sentences.english: I always get a little sad on Sunday evenings because the weekend is over and I have to go back to work the next morning.
sentences.chinese: 周日晚上我总会有点难过，因为周末结束了，第二天一早又要上班。

sentences.english: Have a great weekend!
sentences.chinese: 祝你周末愉快！

sentences.english: We're planning a camping trip in the mountains next weekend.
sentences.chinese: 下个周末我们计划去山里露营。

sentences.english: I love the weekend because I don't have to set an alarm, and I can just do whatever I feel like doing.
sentences.chinese: 我喜欢周末，因为不用设闹钟，想干什么就干什么。

sentences.english: Wash your hands before dinner.
sentences.chinese: 饭前要洗手。

sentences.english: I need to wash the car tomorrow; it's covered in dust.
sentences.chinese: 我明天得洗车，车上全是灰。

sentences.english: After painting the fence, it took me forever to wash all the green paint off my hands and arms.
sentences.chinese: 刷完栅栏后，我花了超长时间才把手上和胳膊上的绿漆洗掉。

sentences.english: I need to wash my clothes.
sentences.chinese: 我需要洗衣服了。

sentences.english: I usually wash my clothes on Sunday afternoon while listening to music.
sentences.chinese: 我通常在周日下午边听音乐边洗衣服。

sentences.english: I forgot to wash my clothes, so I had to wear a slightly wrinkled shirt to the meeting and hope nobody noticed.
sentences.chinese: 我忘了洗衣服，只好穿了件有点皱的衬衫去开会，希望没人注意到。

sentences.english: Let's watch a movie tonight.
sentences.chinese: 我们今晚看电影吧。

sentences.english: I love to watch the sunset from my balcony; it's so peaceful.
sentences.chinese: 我喜欢在阳台看日落，太宁静了。

sentences.english: When I was a kid, I used to watch cartoons every Saturday morning while my parents slept in.
sentences.chinese: 我小时候每个星期六早上都会看动画片，爸妈还在睡懒觉。

sentences.english: Don't watch too much TV.
sentences.chinese: 别看太多电视。

sentences.english: After a long day, I just want to watch TV and relax on the couch.
sentences.chinese: 漫长的一天后，我只想看电视，在沙发上放松。

sentences.english: We used to watch TV together as a family every evening, but now everyone just stares at their own screens.
sentences.chinese: 我们以前每晚全家一起看电视，但现在每个人都只盯着自己的屏幕。

sentences.english: What do you do?
sentences.chinese: 你是做什么工作的？

sentences.english: I have so much work to do before the deadline.
sentences.chinese: 截止日期前我有好多工作要做。

sentences.english: If you don't know what to do with your free time, try learning something new—you might discover a hidden talent.
sentences.chinese: 如果你不知道空闲时间做什么，试试学点新东西——你可能会发现隐藏的天赋。

sentences.english: I have to do homework.
sentences.chinese: 我得做作业了。

sentences.english: I usually do homework right after dinner so I can relax later.
sentences.chinese: 我通常晚饭后就做作业，这样晚点就能放松了。

sentences.english: My little brother always tries to find excuses not to do his homework, like saying the dog ate his pencil.
sentences.chinese: 我弟弟总是找借口不做作业，比如说狗吃了他的铅笔。

sentences.english: I love to read before bed.
sentences.chinese: 我喜欢睡前看书。

sentences.english: Can you read this paragraph and tell me what you think?
sentences.chinese: 你能读一下这段然后告诉我你的想法吗？

sentences.english: When I was on vacation, I read three novels in a week because I had nothing else to do on the beach.
sentences.chinese: 度假时我一周读了三本小说，因为在海滩上无事可做。

sentences.english: I like to read books.
sentences.chinese: 我喜欢读书。

sentences.english: She reads books to her younger brother every night before bed.
sentences.chinese: 她每晚睡前都给弟弟读书。

sentences.english: My goal this year is to read at least 20 books, and I'm already halfway there by March.
sentences.chinese: 我今年的目标是至少读20本书，三月份我已经读了一半了。

sentences.english: Let's play outside!
sentences.chinese: 我们去外面玩吧！

sentences.english: I learned to play the guitar when I was in high school.
sentences.chinese: 我高中时学会了弹吉他。

sentences.english: The kids were playing so loudly in the backyard that I couldn't concentrate, but their laughter made me smile anyway.
sentences.chinese: 孩子们在后院玩得太大声，我无法专心，但他们的笑声还是让我笑了。

sentences.english: Let's play football after school.
sentences.chinese: 放学后我们去踢足球吧。

sentences.english: Every Saturday, we play football in the park with our neighbors.
sentences.chinese: 每周六我们都和邻居在公园踢足球。

sentences.english: When it snows, we still play football outside, but it's more like slipping and sliding than actually running.
sentences.chinese: 下雪时我们还在外面踢足球，但与其说是在跑，不如说是在滑来滑去。

sentences.english: I love Italian cooking.
sentences.chinese: 我喜欢意大利菜。

sentences.english: Cooking together is a great way to spend time with friends.
sentences.chinese: 一起做饭是和朋友相处的好方式。

sentences.english: I used to find cooking stressful, but now I put on music and treat it like a relaxing experiment.
sentences.chinese: 我以前觉得做饭压力很大，但现在我会放着音乐，把它当成放松的实验。

sentences.english: I often walk to school.
sentences.chinese: 我经常走路上学。

sentences.english: How often do you visit your grandparents?
sentences.chinese: 你多久去看一次爷爷奶奶？

sentences.english: I often find myself thinking about that vacation we took two years ago because it was the most relaxing time of my life.
sentences.chinese: 我经常回想起两年前我们度过的那个假期，那是我一生中最放松的时光。

sentences.english: Let's go to the park.
sentences.chinese: 我们去公园吧。

sentences.english: The park near my house has a beautiful lake where we can feed ducks.
sentences.chinese: 我家附近的公园有个美丽的湖，可以喂鸭子。

sentences.english: When I was a child, my dad would take me to the park every Sunday and push me on the swings for hours.
sentences.chinese: 小时候爸爸每个周日都带我去公园，推着我荡秋千好几个小时。

sentences.english: I'm so tired today.
sentences.chinese: 今天我好累。

sentences.english: After staying up late to finish the project, I woke up feeling more tired than before.
sentences.chinese: 熬夜完成项目后，我醒来觉得比之前还累。

sentences.english: Even though I was tired from the long hike, the view from the top of the mountain made every step worth it.
sentences.chinese: 虽然长途徒步让我很累，但山顶的景色让每一步都值得。

sentences.english: What's your favorite sport?
sentences.chinese: 你最喜欢的运动是什么？

sentences.english: Playing a sport regularly helps you stay healthy and make friends.
sentences.chinese: 定期做运动有助于保持健康和交朋友。

sentences.english: I was never good at any sport as a kid, but now I enjoy running just for the fresh air and the time alone.
sentences.chinese: 我小时候什么运动都不擅长，但现在我喜欢跑步，只是为了呼吸新鲜空气和独处时光。

sentences.english: I play sports every afternoon.
sentences.chinese: 我每天下午都做运动。

sentences.english: My doctor said I need to play sports more often to stay healthy.
sentences.chinese: 医生说我需要经常运动来保持健康。

sentences.english: Even when it's cold outside, I try to play sports indoors like badminton or volleyball to keep myself active.
sentences.chinese: 即使外面很冷，我也会在室内做做羽毛球、排球之类的运动，让自己保持活力。

sentences.english: You should try it.
sentences.chinese: 你应该试试。

sentences.english: I think we should leave early to avoid the traffic jam.
sentences.chinese: 我觉得我们应该早点走，避开堵车。

sentences.english: When you feel overwhelmed, you should take a step back and do something you enjoy for a while.
sentences.chinese: 当你感到不堪重负时，应该退一步，做点喜欢的事情缓一缓。
sentences.scene: 给处于压力中的朋友建议

sentences.english: Every student passed the test.
sentences.chinese: 每个学生都通过了考试。

sentences.english: I check my email every morning before I even have breakfast.
sentences.chinese: 我每天早上吃早饭前都会查看邮件。

sentences.english: Every time I hear that song, it reminds me of our road trip across the country.
sentences.chinese: 每次听到那首歌，我都会想起我们的自驾横跨全国之旅。

sentences.english: Have a nice day!
sentences.chinese: 祝你今天愉快！

sentences.english: I spent the whole day organizing my closet and now I'm exhausted.
sentences.chinese: 我花了一整天整理衣柜，现在累坏了。

sentences.english: Some days everything goes wrong, but you just have to believe that the next day will be better.
sentences.chinese: 有些日子诸事不顺，但你得相信明天会更好。

sentences.english: What's on the schedule today?
sentences.chinese: 今天有什么安排？

sentences.english: My schedule is so packed that I barely have time for lunch.
sentences.chinese: 我的日程太满了，几乎没时间吃午饭。

sentences.english: I like to schedule my workouts in the morning because it sets a positive tone for the rest of the day.
sentences.chinese: 我喜欢把锻炼安排在早上，因为这会给一天剩下时间定下积极的基调。
